operator: Madhya Pradesh State Mining Corporation Ltd

name: Pradhan Industries graphite mine, Bandhamundi

name: Pradhan Industries graphite mine, Banibasa
does: One of the five principal graphite producers listed by the Indian Bureau of Mines in 2022-23.

name: Kayad zinc-lead mine (cadmium-bearing)

name: Khetri copper mine and concentrator

name: Kolihan copper mine

name: RSMML Jhamarkotra rock phosphate mine and beneficiation plant

name: Rajpura Dariba zinc-lead mine (cadmium-bearing)

name: Rampura Agucha zinc-lead mine (cadmium-bearing)

name: Sindesar Khurd zinc-lead mine (cadmium-bearing)

name: Zawar group of zinc-lead mines (cadmium-bearing)

name: IREL Manavalakurichi beach-sand mining and mineral separation

name: TAMIN graphite mine and beneficiation, Sivaganga

name: Critical mineral processing park, Andhra Pradesh (site not finalised)

does: A planned government park for rare earths, titanium and zirconium; the site is not yet chosen.

name: Hindustan Zinc Vizag zinc smelter
detail: Operation suspended since 2002 (cadmium capacity 115 tpy)
does: A Hindustan Zinc smelter in Visakhapatnam, idle since 2002.

name: ReNew ingot and wafer plant, Rambilli
detail: MoU and SIPB clearance Dec 2025; commercial operation targeted Jan 2028
does: Plans a 6 GW ingot and wafer plant at Rambilli, supported under the solar PLI scheme.

name: Tata Power ingot and wafer plant, Nellore
does: Plans a 10 GW ingot and wafer plant in Nellore district.

name: Vishnu Strontium carbonate plant, Visakhapatnam
detail: Commercial operations from Q2 FY26; customer approvals expected by Q4 FY26, regular sales from Q1 FY27
operator: Vishnu Strontium Private Limited (Vishnu Chemicals Limited)
does: Makes strontium carbonate, mainly for ferrite magnets, at a Visakhapatnam plant that Vishnu Chemicals bought in 2024 and started in 2025.

name: BALCO Korba plant (vanadium sludge)
does: Recovers vanadium-rich sludge at Vedanta's Korba aluminium complex.

name: Vedanta Nicomet nickel and cobalt refinery, Cuncolim
detail: India's only nickel producer; cobalt metal and salts 1,000 tpy
does: Refines imported nickel and cobalt intermediates into metal, salts and battery-grade nickel sulphate.

name: Adani Solar ingot and wafer plant, Mundra
detail: 2 GW ingot-wafer line in production since 2024 on imported polysilicon; polysilicon targeted 2027/28

name: Critical mineral processing park, Dahej (proposed)

does: A planned government park around Dahej for rare-earth permanent magnet manufacturing.

name: Hindalco Birla Copper smelter and refinery, Dahej
detail: 500,000 tpy port-based smelter on imported concentrate; tellurium recovered from refinery slime

name: Kutch Copper smelter and refinery, Mundra

name: Manikaran lithium hydroxide refinery (proposed), Gujarat

name: Reliance polysilicon and wafer plants, Jamnagar
detail: Wafer pilot plant done; polysilicon construction nearly complete and entering commissioning
does: Is commissioning polysilicon and wafer lines at Reliance's integrated solar complex in Jamnagar.

name: Hindalco Muri alumina refinery (vanadium sludge)
does: Separates vanadium-rich sludge as a by-product of alumina refining.

name: Hindustan Copper ICC smelter and refinery, Ghatsila
detail: Smelting and refining suspended since 2019 for business reasons
does: Is Hindustan Copper's primary smelter for ore from its Singhbhum mines, idle since 2019.

name: Hindalco Belagavi alumina refinery (vanadium sludge)
does: Separates vanadium-rich sludge as a by-product of alumina refining.

name: Cochin Minerals and Rutile synthetic rutile plant, Edayar
detail: 50,000 tpy export-oriented synthetic rutile, now mostly on imported ilmenite
does: Exports synthetic rutile made largely from imported ilmenite at a plant near Kochi.

name: Edayar Zinc (Binani Zinc) smelter, Binanipuram
detail: Operation suspended since April 2014 (cadmium capacity 80 tpy)
does: A 38,000-tonne zinc smelter near Kochi, idle since April 2014.

name: KMML titanium complex, Chavara

name: KMML-SAIL titanium sponge joint venture (proposed), Chavara

name: Travancore Titanium Products TiO2 plant, Kochuveli

name: BARC beryllium plant, Vashi

name: Critical mineral processing park, Dighi Port (proposed)

operator: Ministry of Mines (NCMM) with Government of Odisha

name: IREUK Titanium slag plant (IREL-UKTMP), Odisha
detail: JV agreement Nov 2024; company incorporated Aug 2025; plant site not announced
operator: IREUK Titanium Ltd (IREL with UKTMP JSC, Kazakhstan)

name: NALCO gallium extraction plant, Damanjodi alumina refinery

does: Plans to recover gallium, a chip and LED metal, from the alumina liquor at NALCO's Koraput refinery.

name: Vedanta Lanjigarh alumina refinery (vanadium pentoxide extraction)

name: Hindustan Copper KCC smelter and refinery, Khetri
detail: 31,000 tpy smelter suspended since December 2008; the Khetri concentrator still runs
does: Hindustan Copper's Rajasthan smelter, shut since 2008 for economic reasons.

name: Hindustan Zinc Chanderiya lead-zinc smelter (cadmium recovery)

name: Hindustan Zinc Debari zinc smelter (cadmium recovery)
detail: Zinc smelter operating (88,000 tpy); cadmium capacity 250 tpy, no cadmium output reported since 2017-18

name: DCW synthetic rutile plant, Sahupuram
detail: 48,000 tpy synthetic rutile from Manavalakurichi ilmenite, alongside chlor-alkali and PVC

name: NFC Zirconium Complex, Palayakayal

operator: Nuclear Fuel Complex, Department of Atomic Energy

name: Sterlite Copper smelter, Thoothukudi

does: Was India's second-largest copper smelter until Tamil Nadu ordered it shut in May 2018.

name: Altmin-Singareni lithium carbonate refinery, Telangana
detail: MoU Dec 2025 for 30,000 t/yr; ore from Brazil; target 2027
operator: Altmin Pvt. Ltd. with The Singareni Collieries Company Ltd
does: Plans a 30,000-tonne lithium carbonate refinery in Telangana fed with Brazilian ore.

name: Nuclear Fuel Complex special materials plant, Hyderabad
detail: Makes high-purity metals and tantalum and niobium products; no capacity published
operator: Nuclear Fuel Complex, Department of Atomic Energy

name: Nuclear Fuel Complex zirconium plants, Hyderabad
detail: Zirconium oxide output 605 t in 2021-22; zircaloy fabrication on site
operator: Nuclear Fuel Complex, Department of Atomic Energy
does: Turns zircon into zirconium oxide, sponge and zircaloy tubes for India's reactors.

name: Hindalco Renukoot alumina refinery (vanadium sludge; past gallium)
detail: Vanadium sludge separated in the Bayer process; gallium recovery not current
does: Separates vanadium-rich sludge as a by-product of alumina refining; it also recovered gallium in the past.

name: Hindustan Zinc Pantnagar metal plant (antimony by-product)
detail: 1,400 TPA antimony concentrate recovered as a by-product; India has no primary antimony production

name: NPSPL cathode material plant, Gudupalle
detail: Approved by Andhra Pradesh under its electronics component policy; 105 acres

name: Acutaas Chemicals electrolyte additives plant, Jhagadia
detail: New plant validated and supplying since Jul 2026; phase 2 (third additive) finishing by end Q2 FY27
does: Makes vinylene carbonate and fluoroethylene carbonate, the additives that lengthen lithium-ion cell life, under long-term export contracts.

name: GFCL EV battery materials complex, Jolva
detail: Phase I commissioned; LiPF6 selling to global electrolyte makers; LFP and PVDF sales due H2 FY27; anode unit being built

name: Neogen Ionics electrolyte and LiPF6 plant, Pakhajan (Dahej PCPIR)

name: Neogen Ionics electrolyte and lithium salt plant, Dahej
detail: 2,000 MT electrolyte line running since FY25; 200 of 1,500 MTPA salt capacity commissioned, rest in trials; 1,000 MTPA more by H2 FY27
does: Makes lithium-ion electrolyte and is commissioning lithium salt lines at Neogen's Dahej site.

name: Sudeep Advanced Materials iron phosphate (pCAM) plant, Gujarat
detail: 200 kg/day pilot line shipping trial material; 35,000 tpa targeted by 2027
does: Makes battery-grade iron phosphate, the precursor that LFP cathode makers react with lithium, at pilot scale.

name: Epsilon Advanced Materials graphite anode plant (EAM-ONE), Vijayanagar
detail: Customer qualification plant running; commercial expansion to 30,000 tpa approved under ECMS (Aug 2026), due 2028
does: Makes graphite anode material at a qualification plant so that cell makers can test it before Epsilon builds commercial lines.

name: Epsilon CAM LFP cathode plant, Karnataka

name: SRF Altech battery aluminium foil plant, Jetapur
detail: Board approval 21 Oct 2026; phase I 12,000 MTPA by Sept 2028, phase II by Sept 2030
does: A planned battery-grade aluminium foil line at SRF Altech's existing Jetapur site.

name: TACC synthetic graphite anode plant, Dewas
detail: Construction under way on a 100-acre site; operations due Q1 2027
does: Is building a 20,000-tonne-a-year synthetic graphite anode plant near Indore for EV and storage cells.

name: Himadri LFP cathode active material plant, Odisha
detail: Phase 1 of 40,000 MTPA (Rs 1,125 crore) on schedule for Q3 FY27
does: Is building a 40,000-tonne-a-year plant to make lithium iron phosphate, the cathode material used in most new EV and storage cells.

name: Hindalco battery-grade aluminium foil plant, Sambalpur
detail: Commissioned Jan 2026 with a 1.7 lakh tpa rolling mill; sized for up to 100 GWh of cells
does: Rolls aluminium from Hindalco's Sambalpur smelter into the thin foil that carries the cathode in every lithium-ion cell.

name: LOHUM cathode active material and recycling plant, Krishnagiri
detail: 65 acres bought; production was targeted within 18 months of Jul 2024; no later progress report found
does: Plans a plant that recycles 20,000 tonnes of used batteries a year and turns the recovered metals into cathode active material.

name: Altmin LFP cathode plant, Divitipally

name: Himadri anode material plant, Mahistikry
detail: 200 MTPA first line in production since Apr 2026

name: IREL Rare Earth Permanent Magnet (REPM) Plant, Visakhapatnam

name: Proterial India sintered NdFeB magnet plant, Atchutapuram

detail: Inaugurated May 2026; pilot plants for La, Ce and Nd metals, magnet and phosphor recycling, and titanium; seven technologies offered to industry in Aug 2026

name: IREL Rare Earth Extraction Plant (REEP), OSCOM Chatrapur

name: Andover lithium project, Western Australia: Indian PSU evaluation
detail: Owner paused the sale in June 2025 and reopened it in Feb 2026; joint evaluation under way
operator: KABIL with Oil India, Coal India and NLC India
does: KABIL and three state companies are evaluating a minority stake with offtake in the Andover lithium project.

name: Indian PSU consortium bid for Mt Marion lithium mine, Western Australia
detail: Offers Dec 2024 and Sept 2025 lost to POSCO, which took 15% of Mt Marion and Wodgina
operator: KABIL with Coal India, Oil India and ONGC Videsh
does: The consortium offered first USD 184 million, then AUD 325 million, for stakes in Mt Marion and Wodgina through Mineral Resources.

name: Indian PSU consortium bid for Wodgina lithium mine, Western Australia
detail: Offers Dec 2024 and Sept 2025 lost to POSCO, which took 15% of Mt Marion and Wodgina
operator: KABIL with Coal India, Oil India and ONGC Videsh
does: Sold together with Mt Marion; the Indian consortium sought 20% of each mine.

name: Mt Holland lithium project, Western Australia: Indian PSU evaluation
detail: Owner paused the sale in June 2025 and reopened it in Feb 2026; joint evaluation under way
operator: KABIL with Oil India, Coal India and NLC India
does: KABIL and three state companies are evaluating a minority stake with offtake in the Mt Holland lithium mine.

name: ChemVolt Global cell gigafactory, Andhra Pradesh
detail: MoU with Andhra Pradesh; 1 GWh by Q3 2027, 5 GWh by Q2 2029
does: A planned 5 GWh plant for large prismatic cells aimed at grid storage and heavy EVs.

name: Waaree lithium-ion gigafactory, Rambilli
detail: In-principle approval from the Andhra Pradesh State Investment Promotion Board, Feb 2026
does: A planned 16 GWh plant covering cells, packs and grid storage systems.

name: Agratas battery cell plant, Sanand
detail: Steel frame complete Apr 2026; NMC cells expected early 2027; LFP pilot line being set up
operator: Agratas Energy Storage Solutions Pvt Ltd (Tata group)
does: Tata's 20 GWh cell plant for EVs and storage, using licensed NMC technology and its own LFP process.

name: Crystal Matrix GaN Mini/Micro-LED fab, Dholera
detail: Approved by the Union Cabinet under the India Semiconductor Mission
does: India's first commercial Mini/Micro-LED display plant based on GaN, also offering GaN foundry services on 6-inch wafers.

name: Reliance battery giga factory, Jamnagar
detail: Civil works complete, equipment being installed; ACC PLI awards of 5 and 10 GWh, none installed by Mar 2026
operator: Reliance New Energy Battery Storage Ltd and Reliance New Energy Battery Ltd (Reliance Industries)
does: A 40 GWh LFP battery plant in Reliance's Jamnagar clean energy complex, holding two ACC PLI awards totalling 15 GWh.

name: ACC Energy Storage cell plant, Dharwad
detail: ACC PLI award of 5 GWh; land acquired; Rs 262 crore invested by Dec 2025; nothing installed
does: A 5 GWh cell plant awarded under the ACC PLI scheme's first round; no capacity built yet.

name: Exide Energy Solutions cell plant, Devanahalli
detail: Phase I (6 GWh) commissioned 23 Sept 2026; LFP cells first go to Exide's own three-wheeler packs
does: A 6 GWh cell plant whose LFP cells will replace imported cells in Exide's Gujarat pack plant.

name: JSW Group cell plant, Odisha
detail: On hold since Aug 2026 for want of an LFP technology partner; group developing its own cell technology
does: A cell plant JSW planned in Odisha to supply its JSW MG Motor electric vehicles.

name: Ola Cell Technologies gigafactory, Krishnagiri
detail: 1.4 GWh installed; pilot output since Mar 2024, not yet at full commercial scale; 20 GWh awarded under ACC PLI
does: The only ACC PLI plant making cells so far; it is still stabilising pilot production.

name: Amara Raja Giga Corridor cell plant, Divitipally
detail: 60 MWh qualification plant commissioned Jul 2026; first 2 GWh of commercial cells due June 2027
does: Makes sample cells for carmakers to qualify ahead of a 16 GWh gigafactory on the same 260-acre site.

name: GAETEC gallium arsenide fab, Hyderabad
detail: Makes GaAs microwave chips for defence; GaN-on-SiC chip production added
does: DRDO's strategic fab for gallium arsenide and gallium nitride microwave chips used in radar and electronic warfare.

name: GODI India cell plant, Telangana
detail: MoU Jan 2024 for 12.5 GWh; no later progress report found
does: A planned 12.5 GWh lithium- and sodium-ion cell plant.
